description: On the table there’s a tall black tube with a red lid, a dark shirt, and the red lid lying off to the side. The left hand holds the tube steady as the right hand lifts the red lid off, stuffs the dark shirt down into the tube opening, then pulls the shirt back out and sets it to the right before pressing the red lid back onto the top; the tube is a left-hand object during stuffing and re-lidding.
